text:
katie: FYI — customer reported that their exported audit stream is missing several 'kms.decrypt' events from last night. ticket #C-9342. can security help verify?

sanjay: copy. any example event ids or times from the customer?

katie: they sent this snippet from their side: 
```
{"event_type":"kms.decrypt","resource":"key-prod-07","timestamp":"2026-03-18T23:42:11Z","actor":"svc-order-processor"}
```
They say internal portal shows only 'kms.access_check' events around that time.

priya: is the customer using Private deployment or Hosted? affects which audit pipeline they read.

katie: Hosted (api.redwood.com) org: acme-corp (org id masked).

alex: can we query our audit pipeline for that org/time range? I can run a quick search in the lake.

santiago: pinging the audit-bot to pull canonical events.

audit-bot: ingest-query: org=acme-corp from=2026-03-18T23:30:00Z to=2026-03-18T23:50:00Z -> 42 events found. types: kms.access_check(28), kms.decrypt(0), kms.encrypt(5), api.request(9).

sanjay: interesting — bot shows zero kms.decrypt events in the canonical store. but customer has them in their export. possibilities: 1) export includes synthesized events from client side, 2) schema rename or mapping mismatch during export, 3) RBAC filter removed those events for hosted customers at export time.

priya: also check if there was a recent schema migration — we changed audit event 'kms.decrypt' -> 'kms.kdf.decrypt' in staging two weeks ago for proto v2. if export pipeline still maps to v1 names inconsistently, that could explain it.

alex: I pulled the raw events around that time. snippet from our canonical log (redacted):
```
2026-03-18T23:41:59Z | org=acme-corp | event_type=kms.access_check | actor=svc-order-processor | key=key-prod-07
2026-03-18T23:42:12Z | org=acme-corp | event_type=kms.encrypt | actor=svc-order-processor | key=key-prod-07
```
No decrypt entry.

sanjay: can someone check KMS proxy logs? maybe decrypts were proxied to customer-managed key store and emitted differently.

santiago: grabbing KMS proxy logs for key-prod-07.

(small pause)

santiago: found a proxied call at 2026-03-18T23:42:10Z with status=200 but the proxy emitted event_type=kms.kdf.decrypt in its internal logs. looks like a new microservice (kms-kdf-adapter) introduced that name.

priya: that aligns with the schema rename note. export tooling probably still filters for event_type == 'kms.decrypt' when constructing customer-facing audit bundles. the adapter emitted 'kms.kdf.decrypt' so it got dropped.

katie: do we surface that to the customer? they expect traditional names.

sanjay: two actions: short term — include fallback mapping in export (treat 'kms.kdf.decrypt' as 'kms.decrypt' for backwards compatibility). long term — update schema docs and notify customers.

alex: i'll push a one-line patch to the audit-exporter to coalesce the names for the last 90 days. can we do hotfix in Hosted?

priya: +1 but get compliance sign-off. we need to add a migration note in the audit schema changelog and include a flag so private deployments can opt out. Also record the mapping in change control (ticket internal CHG-1923).

sanjay: incident investigation note: this is not a data loss event — customer had events but under a different event_type. mark severity low/medium. still need to update any downstream detection rules that rely on exact event_type matches.

katie: customer asked for timeline reconstruction template for support. can we attach the canonical events (with mapped types) and a short explanation?

santiago: yes. I'll generate a timeline: include proxied call, adapter mapping, export filter, and our remediation patch.

audit-bot: change-log-entry created: CHG-1923 -> "audit: map kms.kdf.decrypt -> kms.decrypt in exporter for compatibility" by alex at 2026-03-19T00:05:00Z

priya: also check KMS key permissions: was there any RBAC change around that org/key yesterday?

sanjay: I queried IAM history — no policy updates on key-prod-07 in the 7 days prior.

alex: deploying patch to canary (hosted-exporter-canary) now. will run export for acme-corp and compare.

(about 10m later)

alex: canary run complete. customer export now contains 3 kms.decrypt events at 23:42:11-23:42:15. snippet: 
```
{"event_type":"kms.decrypt","resource":"key-prod-07","timestamp":"2026-03-18T23:42:12Z","actor":"svc-order-processor","note":"mapped from kms.kdf.decrypt"}
```

katie: forwarding to support to close the loop with customer. include changelog entry and timeline.

sanjay: follow-up: we should add a unit test to exporter that accepts a small matrix of renamed types so we don't regress. i'll create a quick test.

priya: and update customer-facing audit schema doc + send a short notice to Hosted customers who have KMS integrations.

katie: thanks team. marking this thread resolved once support confirms customer satisfied. :white_check_mark:
